off.ask: Turn on notifications to hear about new orders and messages on this phone.
off.denied: Notifications are off for this app. Turn them on in your phone's settings.

errors.cameraPermission: Allow camera access to take a photo.
errors.unreadableFile: This file could not be opened. Choose it again.
errors.tooLarge: This file exceeds the upload size allowed by the store.
errors.unsupportedType: The store does not accept this file type.
errors.cancelled: The upload was stopped. Check its status before trying again.
errors.scopeChanged: Open the original workspace and account to check this upload.

returns.title: Returns
returns.emptyBody: Returns matching these filters will appear here.
returns.quantityHint: Select quantities from the store's eligible items. Each seller may receive a separate return.
returns.confirmCreateBody: Create the return cases with these items, quantities and evidence?
returns.validation: Check required fields and quantities before continuing.
returns.actionUnavailable: The store no longer offers this action. Refresh the return to see available actions.
returns.caseQuantities: Use the return's approved and received quantities. Disposition applies only to units received and still unassigned.
returns.alreadySentHint: Record only money already sent to the customer. This does not transfer money.
returns.confirmAction: Apply this action with the selected quantities and details?
returns.confirmSettlement: Confirm the customer already received this payment and record its reference?
returns.confirmRefundBody: Confirm the store's quoted refund of {amount}?
returns.manualRequiredHint: An external payment is still required. Record settlement only after the customer receives it.
returns.refundAmountHint: Leave amount and all item quantities blank or zero for the store's full eligible refund. Select quantities or enter an amount for a partial refund. The store calculates the final amount.
returns.quoteExpired: The quote expired. Review again before confirming.
returns.refundReviewHint: These amounts, destination and stock effects come from the store. Confirm before this quote expires.
returns.label: Return label
returns.uploadPending: File upload needs confirmation before continuing.
returns.unconfirmed: The original operation is not confirmed. Check its status before making another change. No new payment will be sent by checking.
returns.unavailableBody: This store does not support this native workflow yet. Use its dashboard until the API is updated.
returns.discardBody: These unsaved return or refund details will be removed.
returns.discardUnconfirmed: These details will be removed. The original operation stays unconfirmed: check it when you open this again.
returns.cannotDiscard: Wait for uploads and requests to finish before leaving.
returns.notReceivedBody: The store didn't receive this request, so nothing changed. Review the details and send it again.
returns.manualOrderHint: The customer still needs an external payment. Record its settlement on the website once it has been sent.

settlementHints.processing: The store is processing the payment. Status refreshes automatically. Do not send another refund.
settlementHints.succeeded: The store confirmed the refund's settlement.
settlementHints.failed: The store reported a failed settlement. Refresh and review the return before any further attempt.
settlementHints.manual_required: The customer still needs an external payment. Record settlement on the return after payment is received.
